get.summary: NEW: Get the list of all the SBI details created by Device Providers
get.description:
This endpoint is for both regular users and the Partner Admin users.

This endpoint supports pagination, sorting, and filtering based on optional query parameters.

If the token used to access this endpoint, does not have the PARTNER_ADMIN role, then it will fetch all the SBI's created by all the Device Providers associated with the logged in user only.

If the token used to access this endpoint, has PARTNER_ADMIN role, then it will fetch all the SBI's created by all the Device Providers across all users.

This endpoint is designed to support the upcoming feature "Multi Partner Type Support for a User".
With this feature one PMS user account will be able to support multiple Partner Types.
Currently one PMS user account maps to one Partner Type and one Partner Id.  

This endpoint upgrades the earlier GET endpoint `/partners/securebiometricinterface/search` 
by adding new features like:
1. Performance improvement
2. Handling `deactivated` status
3. Adding details of associated devices (`countOfAssociatedDevices, countOfApprovedDevices, countOfPendingDevices`)

This endpoint should be configured for the Roles: DEVICE_PROVIDER, PARTNER_ADMIN

This endpoint will also be used to populate the Count of expiring SBI's in the 
corresponding Dashboard Card by passing the `expiryPeriod` optional request parameter.

post.summary: NEW: Add a new device and also add an inactive mapping to SBI
post.description:
This endpoint adds a new device and also an in active mapping between an SBI with status as "approved" 
and Device with status as "pending_approval" .

As per existing tables `pms.device_detail`, `pms.device_detail_sbi` and `pms.secure_biometric_interface` 
there is no direct parent child relation ship between a device and SBI. But as per new UI design we need to incorporate the same. 
To do so, whenever a device is created, the UI will call this endpoint which will first add a new the device in DB and also add an in active mapping between device and SBI.
Later when Partner Admin will approve the Device, the mapping will also be activated.

As per new UI design. a device should not exist without being associated with a SBI.
To support this, whenever any error occurs while adding the inactive mapping between a device and SBI, 
instead of leaving the orphaned device in DB, this endpoint will delete it.

This endpoint should be configured for the Roles: DEVICE_PROVIDER,PARTNER_ADMIN

get.summary: NEW: Get list of all the Partner Id's associated with logged in User and filtered by Query Parameters
get.description:
This endpoint will fetch list of all the partners based on the query parameters.

This endpoint is designed to support the upcoming feature "Multi Partner Type Support for a User".
With this feature one PMS user account will be able to support multiple Partner Types.
Currently one PMS user account maps to one Partner Type and one Partner Id.  

The query parameter `status` is mandatory. The endpoint will return all 
Partner Id's with corresponding status value and which are mapped 
to the logged in user. If there are no Partner Id's with corresponding status 
and which are mapped to the logged in user, then it will return an empty array as the response.
A Partner is auto approved by the PMS system, after the partner uploads
a valid CA signed certificate for the organisation.


The query parameter `policyGroupAvailable` is optional. If it is true, then this endpoint will return all 
Partner Id's which have a Policy Group associated with them and which are mapped 
to the logged in user. If there are no Partner Id's which have a Policy Group associated with them 
and which are mapped to the logged in user, then it will return an empty array as the response.

The query parameter `partnerType` is optional. If it is any of allowed partner types, then this endpoint will return all 
Partner Id's which have same partner type and which are mapped 
to the logged in user. If there are no Partner Id's which have same partner type
and which are mapped to the logged in user, then it will return an empty array as the response.

All these 3 query parameters will work together.If the partner type is provided as `MISP_Partner`, e.g., `/partners/v4?status=approved&partnerType=MISP_Partner`:
- If the logged-in user is Admin, all MISP_Partner records are returned.
- If the logged-in user is not Admin, only MISP_Partner records mapped to the logged-in user are returned.

Example 1: `/partners/v4?status=approved&partnerType=Device_Provider&policyGroupAvailable=false`
this will return list of all Device Provider ids which are in approved status and are associated 
with logged in user and but the policy group attributes in the response will be null in this case.

Example 2: `/partners/v4?status=approved&partnerType=Device_Provider&policyGroupAvailable=true`
this will return an empty list since policy group is not available for Device Providers

This endpoint should be configured for the Roles: DEVICE_PROVIDER,FTM_PROVIDER,PARTNER_ADMIN,AUTH_PARTNER,ABIS_PARTNER,
SDK_PARTNER,CREDENTIAL_PARTNER,PARTNER_ADMIN,ONLINE_VERIFICATION_PARTNER

patch.description:

This endpoint will check if the SBI Id belongs to the logged in user or not.

This endpoint will check if the SBI is has status as "approved" and value for "is_active" column as "true".

On deactivation the corresponding record in DB, will have status as "approved" and 
value for "is_active" column will be "false".

1. The associated device with status status as "approved" and value for "is_active" column as "true" will be changed to status as "approved" and value for "is_active" column will be "false".
2. The associated device with status status as "pending_approval" will be changed to status as "rejected".

This endpoint should be configured for the Roles: DEVICE_PROVIDER,PARTNER_ADMIN

get.description:
This endpoint will get all the notifications from the `pms.notifications` table.

The notifications fetched will be for all the partner ids which are linked to the logged in user id, 
which is sent as a Header in the Authorization token.

This endpoint will be used to get the notifications to be displayed in the Notification Panel 
as well as in the View All Notifications page.

This will include optional request parameters to support pagination and filtering. 

The request parameters will include optional paramter, `notificationType`. 
Allowed values for the same will be `root`, `intermediate`, `partner`, `weekly`,`sbi`, `ftm-chip`, `apikey`. 
If the `notificationType` is `root`, `intermediate` or `weekly` then the `PARTNER_ADMIN` 
role is expected in the token. If it is not available then error will be thrown.
